title: Basic
description: Compose Steps from Step children. value is the current step, from 1: steps before it are complete and steps after it upcoming.

title: Vertical with an error
description: orientation="vertical" leaves room for longer descriptions. A step's own state overrides value, here error.

title: Steps as data, clickable
description: steps renders the same children as composition. clickable turns completed steps' titles into buttons that report value-change, so people can go back but not skip ahead.
